data.name: Chandrika
data.gender_notes: Chandrika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Chandrika is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'chandra' meaning 'moon'. This name is a symbol of the moon's light and radiance. In Hindu mythology, Chandrika is an epithet of Goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity. The name Chandrika carries the meaning “Moonbeam, Moonlight, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chandrika usually hope their child will grow to embody moonbeam, moonlight, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine grace and abundance of the moon.
data.etymology: Chandrika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moonbeam, Moonlight, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chandrika total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Chandrika holds great spiritual significance as it symbolizes the divine feminine energy and the shimmering light of the moon. It is a reminder of the divine beauty, grace, and blessings that manifest in our lives. In Hinduism, the moon is also associated with the mind and emotional intelligence, making Chandrika an inspiring name for those seeking to nurture these qualities.
